result.topic_en: Practical consequences of fluid friction in pipes: water cannot be conveyed from a distant source and made to jet unless the reservoir is very high, and with no atmospheric pressure a table relates the friction factor N to the pipe parameter n.
result.transcription:
DE FRICTIONE FLVIDORVM. 387
Si ergo diameter canalis minor esset, quam $\frac{7}{8}$[?] ped. aqua
plane non exsiliret.

118. Patet etiam aquam de loco valde remoto
aduehi non posse, nisi iste locus admodum sit eleuatus:
propterea quod canales non nimis amplos confici licet.
Ita si aqua ex distantia vnius milliaris sit arcessenda,
ita vt sit $b=25000$, et canalium diameter sit $\frac{1}{4}$ pedis,
erit $n=100000$, hoc praestari nequit, nisi receptacu-
lum vltra 750 pedes eleuatum sit supra locum fontis,
Ponamus ergo hanc eleuationem esse $q=1000$ ped. et
aqua ex fonte non vltra altitudinem 10 pedum ascen-
det: sin esset $q=2000$ ped. altitudo iactus prodiret
50 ped. et pro singulis millenis pedibus, quibus alti-
tudo $q$ augetur, altitudo saltus tantum quadragenis pedi-
bus crescit.

119. Si atmosphaera nullam exerceret pressionem,
quantitas M omitti deberet; atque hoc casu aqua per
orificium DD erumperet, dummodo aqua in castello
magis fuerit eleuata. Foret autem $v=Nq$, seu ob
frictionem se haberet CG ad CF, vti numerus N ad
vnitatem; at est $N<1$, nisi $n=0$, et praecipui valo-
res ipsius N sequentibus valoribus ipsius $n$ respondebunt:
$\begin{array}{c|c|c|c|c|c|c|c|c|c|c} N=1 & \frac{3}{4} & \frac{2}{3}[?] & \frac{1}{2} & \frac{1}{3} & \frac{1}{4} & \frac{1}{5} & \frac{1}{6} & \frac{1}{7} & \frac{1}{8} & \frac{1}{9} \\ n=0 & 2400 & 3500 & 6300 & 11300 & 15700 & 19860 & 24000 & 28000 & 32000 & 36000 \end{array}$
Hinc si sit $N=\frac{1}{\nu}$ et $\nu>5$, erit $n=4000\nu$.

items.quote:
Si ergo diameter canalis minor esset, quam $\frac{7}{8}$[?] ped. aqua
plane non exsiliret.
items.english: Therefore if the diameter of the pipe were smaller than 7/8 ft, the water would not spout out at all.

items.quote:
Patet etiam aquam de loco valde remoto
aduehi non posse, nisi iste locus admodum sit eleuatus:
propterea quod canales non nimis amplos confici licet.
items.english: It is also evident that water cannot be brought from a very remote place unless that place is considerably elevated, because pipes cannot be made very wide.

items.quote:
Ita si aqua ex distantia vnius milliaris sit arcessenda,
ita vt sit $b=25000$, et canalium diameter sit $\frac{1}{4}$ pedis,
erit $n=100000$, hoc praestari nequit, nisi receptacu-
lum vltra 750 pedes eleuatum sit supra locum fontis,
items.english: Thus if water is to be fetched from a distance of one mile, so that b = 25000, and the pipe diameter is 1/4 ft, then n = 100000, and this cannot be done unless the reservoir is raised more than 750 feet above the fountain.

items.english: And for every thousand feet by which the height q is increased, the height of the jet grows by only forty feet.
